1CH.28.10.t: Consider now that the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong and do it.”
s: Consider now that the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong and do it.”

1CH.28.11.t: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple, its buildings, storehouses, upper rooms, inner rooms, and the room for the mercy seat.
s: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple, its buildings, storehouses, upper rooms, inner rooms, and the room for the mercy seat.

1CH.28.12.t: The plans contained everything David had in mind for the courts of the house of the LORD, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the house of God and of the dedicated things,
s: The plans contained everything David had in mind for the courts of the house of the LORD, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the house of God and of the dedicated things,

1CH.28.13.t: for the divisions of the priests and Levites, for all the work of service in the house of the LORD, and for all the articles of service in the house of the LORD:
s: for the divisions of the priests and Levites, for all the work of service in the house of the LORD, and for all the articles of service in the house of the LORD:

1CH.28.14.t: the weight of all the gold articles for every kind of service; the weight of all the silver articles for every kind of service;
s: the weight of all the gold articles for every kind of service;
the weight of all the silver articles for every kind of service;

1CH.28.15.t: the weight of the gold lampstands and their lamps, including the weight of each lampstand and its lamps; the weight of each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;
s: the weight of the gold lampstands and their lamps, including the weight of each lampstand and its lamps;
the weight of each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;

1CH.28.16.t: the weight of gold for each table of showbread, and of silver for the silver tables;
s: the weight of gold for each table of showbread, and of silver for the silver tables;

1CH.28.17.t: the weight of the pure gold for the forks, sprinkling bowls, and pitchers; the weight of each gold dish; the weight of each silver bowl;
s: the weight of the pure gold for the forks, sprinkling bowls, and pitchers;
the weight of each gold dish;
the weight of each silver bowl;

1CH.28.18.t: the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense; and the plans for the chariot of the gold cherubim that spread their wings and overshadowed the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
s: the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense;
and the plans for the chariot of the gold cherubim that spread their wings and overshadowed the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

1CH.28.19.t: “All this,” said David, “all the details of this plan, the LORD has made clear to me in writing by His hand upon me.”
s: “All this,” said David, “all the details of this plan, the LORD has made clear to me in writing by His hand upon me.”

1CH.28.20.t: David also said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will neither fail you nor forsake you before all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.
s: David also said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will neither fail you nor forsake you before all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.

1CH.28.21.t: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the service of the house of God, and every willing man of every skill will be at your disposal for the work. The officials and all the people are fully at your command.”
s: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the service of the house of God, and every willing man of every skill will be at your disposal for the work. The officials and all the people are fully at your command.”

1CO.10.6.t: These things took place as examples to keep us from craving evil things as they did.
s: These things took place as examples to keep us from craving evil things as they did.

1CO.10.7.t: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written: “The people sat down to eat and to drink, and got up to indulge in revelry.”
s: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written: “The people sat down to eat and to drink, and got up to indulge in revelry.”

1CO.10.8.t: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.
s: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.

1CO.10.9.t: We should not test Christ, as some of them did, and were killed by snakes.
s: We should not test Christ, as some of them did, and were killed by snakes.

1CO.10.10.t: And do not complain, as some of them did, and were killed by the destroying angel.
s: And do not complain, as some of them did, and were killed by the destroying angel.

1CO.10.11.t: Now these things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come.
s: Now these things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come.

1CO.10.12.t: So the one who thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall.
s: So the one who thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall.

1CO.10.13.t: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.
s: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.

1CO.10.14.t: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
s: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

1CO.12.31.t: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.
s: But eagerly desire the greater gifts.
And now I will show you the most excellent way.

1CO.13.1.t: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
s: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.

1CO.13.2.t: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
s: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.

1CO.13.3.t: If I give all I possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, I gain nothing.
s: If I give all I possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, I gain nothing.

1CO.13.4.t: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
s: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

1CO.13.5.t: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.
s: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.

1CO.13.6.t: Love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.
s: Love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.

1CO.13.7.t: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
s: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

1CO.13.8.t: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be restrained; where there is knowledge, it will be dismissed.
s: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be restrained; where there is knowledge, it will be dismissed.

1CO.13.9.t: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,
s: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,

1CO.13.10.t: but when the perfect comes, the partial passes away.
s: but when the perfect comes, the partial passes away.

1CO.13.11.t: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.
s: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.

1CO.13.12.t: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.
s: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

1CO.13.13.t: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.
s: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.

1CO.16.5.t: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.
s: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.

1CO.16.6.t: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.
s: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.

1CO.16.7.t: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
s: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.

1CO.16.8.t: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
s: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,

1CO.16.9.t: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.
s: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.

1CO.16.10.t: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.
s: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.

1CO.16.11.t: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for I am expecting him along with the brothers.
s: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for I am expecting him along with the brothers.

1CO.16.12.t: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.
s: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.

1CO.16.13.t: Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.
s: Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.
Do everything in love.

1JN.1.5.t: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
s: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

1JN.1.6.t: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
s: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.

1JN.1.7.t: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
s: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.

1JN.1.8.t: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
s: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

1JN.1.9.t: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
s: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

1JN.1.10.t: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
s: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.

1JN.2.1.t: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
s: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

1JN.2.2.t: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
s: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.

1JN.2.28.t: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
s: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.

1JN.2.29.t: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.
s: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.

1JN.3.1.t: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
s: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.

1JN.3.2.t: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
s: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.

1JN.3.3.t: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
s: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.

1JN.4.7.t: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
s: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

1JN.4.8.t: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
s: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

1JN.4.9.t: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
s: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.

1JN.4.10.t: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
s: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

1JN.4.11.t: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
s: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

1JN.4.12.t: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
s: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.

1PE.2.4.t: As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,
s: As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,

1PE.2.5.t: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
s: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

1PE.2.6.t: For it stands in Scripture: “See, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
s: For it stands in Scripture:
“See, I lay in Zion a stone,
a chosen and precious cornerstone;
and the one who believes in Him
will never be put to shame.”

1PE.2.7.t: To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
s: To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe,
“The stone the builders rejected
has become the cornerstone,”

1PE.2.8.t: and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.
s: and,
“A stone of stumbling
and a rock of offense.”
They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.

1PE.2.9.t: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
s: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.

1PE.2.10.t: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
s: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

1PE.3.8.t: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.
s: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.

1PE.3.9.t: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
s: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.

1PE.3.10.t: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
s: For,
“Whoever would love life
and see good days
must keep his tongue from evil
and his lips from deceitful speech.

1PE.3.11.t: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
s: He must turn from evil and do good;
he must seek peace and pursue it.

1PE.3.12.t: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
s: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous,
and His ears are inclined to their prayer.
But the face of the Lord is against
those who do evil.”

1PE.4.7.t: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
s: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.

1PE.4.8.t: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
s: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

1PE.4.9.t: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.
s: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.

1PE.4.10.t: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
s: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.

1PE.4.11.t: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
s: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

1PE.5.5.t: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
s: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because,
“God opposes the proud,
but gives grace to the humble.”

1PE.5.6.t: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
s: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.

1PE.5.7.t: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
s: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.

1PE.5.8.t: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
s: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

1PE.5.9.t: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
s: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.

1PE.5.10.t: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
s: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.

1PE.5.11.t: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.
s: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.

1SA.16.1.t: Now the LORD said to Samuel, “How long are you going to mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and go. I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem, for I have selected from his sons a king for Myself.”
s: Now the LORD said to Samuel, “How long are you going to mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and go. I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem, for I have selected from his sons a king for Myself.”

1SA.16.2.t: “How can I go?” Samuel asked. “Saul will hear of it and kill me!” The LORD answered, “Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.’
s: “How can I go?” Samuel asked. “Saul will hear of it and kill me!”
The LORD answered, “Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.’

1SA.16.3.t: Then invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you are to do. You are to anoint for Me the one I indicate.”
s: Then invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you are to do. You are to anoint for Me the one I indicate.”

1SA.16.4.t: So Samuel did what the LORD had said and went to Bethlehem. When the elders of the town met him, they trembled and asked, “Do you come in peace?”
s: So Samuel did what the LORD had said and went to Bethlehem. When the elders of the town met him, they trembled and asked, “Do you come in peace?”

1SA.16.5.t: “In peace,” he replied. “I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Consecrate yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice.” Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.
s: “In peace,” he replied. “I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Consecrate yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice.”
Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.

1SA.16.6.t: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and said, “Surely here before the LORD is His anointed.”
s: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and said, “Surely here before the LORD is His anointed.”

1SA.16.7.t: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.”
s: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.”

1SA.16.8.t: Then Jesse called Abinadab and presented him to Samuel, who said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”
s: Then Jesse called Abinadab and presented him to Samuel, who said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”

1SA.16.9.t: Next Jesse presented Shammah, but Samuel said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”
s: Next Jesse presented Shammah, but Samuel said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”

1SA.16.10.t: Thus Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel told him, “The LORD has not chosen any of these.”
s: Thus Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel told him, “The LORD has not chosen any of these.”

1SA.16.11.t: And Samuel asked him, “Are these all the sons you have?” “There is still the youngest,” Jesse replied, “but he is tending the sheep.” “Send for him,” Samuel replied. “For we will not sit down to eat until he arrives.”
s: And Samuel asked him, “Are these all the sons you have?”
“There is still the youngest,” Jesse replied, “but he is tending the sheep.”
“Send for him,” Samuel replied. “For we will not sit down to eat until he arrives.”

1SA.16.12.t: So Jesse sent for his youngest son and brought him in. He was ruddy, with beautiful eyes and a handsome appearance. And the LORD said, “Rise and anoint him, for he is the one.”
s: So Jesse sent for his youngest son and brought him in. He was ruddy, with beautiful eyes and a handsome appearance. And the LORD said, “Rise and anoint him, for he is the one.”

1SA.16.13.t: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward. Then Samuel set out and went to Ramah.
s: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward. Then Samuel set out and went to Ramah.

1TH.5.11.t: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
s: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.

1TH.5.12.t: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who preside over you in the Lord and give you instruction.
s: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who preside over you in the Lord and give you instruction.

1TH.5.13.t: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
s: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.

1TH.5.14.t: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
s: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.

1TH.5.15.t: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
s: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
Rejoice at all times.
Pray without ceasing.

1TH.5.18.t: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
s: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
Do not extinguish the Spirit.

1TH.5.20.t: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,
s: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,

1TH.5.21.t: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.
s: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.

1TH.5.22.t: Abstain from every form of evil.
s: Abstain from every form of evil.

1TH.5.23.t: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
s: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1TH.5.24.t: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
s: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
Command and teach these things.

1TI.4.12.t: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
s: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.

1TI.4.13.t: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.
s: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.

1TI.4.14.t: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.
s: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.

1TI.4.15.t: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
s: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.

1TI.4.16.t: Pay close attention to your life and to your teaching. Persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
s: Pay close attention to your life and to your teaching. Persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

2CO.1.3.t: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,
s: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

2CO.1.4.t: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.
s: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.

2CO.1.5.t: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.
s: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.

2CO.1.6.t: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.
s: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.

2CO.1.7.t: And our hope for you is sure, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.
s: And our hope for you is sure, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.

2CO.1.8.t: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of Asia. We were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.
s: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of Asia. We were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.

2CO.1.9.t: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.
s: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.

2CO.1.10.t: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and He will deliver us. In Him we have placed our hope that He will yet again deliver us,
s: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and He will deliver us. In Him we have placed our hope that He will yet again deliver us,

2CO.1.11.t: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the favor shown us in answer to their prayers.
s: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the favor shown us in answer to their prayers.

2CO.3.1.t: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?
s: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?

2CO.3.2.t: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
s: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.

2CO.3.3.t: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
s: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.

2CO.3.4.t: Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.
s: Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.

2CO.3.5.t: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from God.
s: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from God.

2CO.3.6.t: And He has qualified us as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
s: And He has qualified us as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

2CO.12.7.t: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.
s: or because of these surpassingly great revelations.
So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.

2CO.12.8.t: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.
s: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.

2CO.12.9.t: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
s: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.

2CO.12.10.t: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
s: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

2SA.9.1.t: Then David asked, “Is there anyone left from the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for the sake of Jonathan?”
s: Then David asked, “Is there anyone left from the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for the sake of Jonathan?”

2SA.9.2.t: And there was a servant of Saul’s family named Ziba. They summoned him to David, and the king inquired, “Are you Ziba?” “I am your servant,” he replied.
s: And there was a servant of Saul’s family named Ziba. They summoned him to David, and the king inquired, “Are you Ziba?”
“I am your servant,” he replied.

2SA.9.3.t: So the king asked, “Is there anyone left of Saul’s family to whom I can show the kindness of God?” Ziba answered, “There is still Jonathan’s son, who is lame in both feet.”
s: So the king asked, “Is there anyone left of Saul’s family to whom I can show the kindness of God?”
Ziba answered, “There is still Jonathan’s son, who is lame in both feet.”

2SA.9.4.t: “Where is he?” replied the king. And Ziba said, “Indeed, he is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir son of Ammiel.”
s: “Where is he?” replied the king.
And Ziba said, “Indeed, he is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir son of Ammiel.”

2SA.9.5.t: So King David had him brought from the house of Machir son of Ammiel in Lo-debar.
s: So King David had him brought from the house of Machir son of Ammiel in Lo-debar.

2SA.9.6.t: And when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he fell facedown in reverence. Then David said, “Mephibosheth!” “I am your servant,” he replied.
s: And when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he fell facedown in reverence.
Then David said, “Mephibosheth!”
“I am your servant,” he replied.

2SA.9.7.t: “Do not be afraid,” said David, “for surely I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table.”
s: “Do not be afraid,” said David, “for surely I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table.”

2SA.9.8.t: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, “What is your servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog like me?”
s: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, “What is your servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog like me?”

2SA.9.9.t: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba and said to him, “I have given to your master’s grandson all that belonged to Saul and to all his house.
s: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba and said to him, “I have given to your master’s grandson all that belonged to Saul and to all his house.

2SA.9.10.t: You and your sons and servants are to work the ground for him and bring in the harvest, so that your master’s grandson may have food to eat. But Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson, is always to eat at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
s: You and your sons and servants are to work the ground for him and bring in the harvest, so that your master’s grandson may have food to eat. But Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson, is always to eat at my table.”
Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

2SA.9.11.t: And Ziba said to the king, “Your servant will do all that my lord the king has commanded.” So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s own sons.
s: And Ziba said to the king, “Your servant will do all that my lord the king has commanded.”
So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s own sons.

2SA.9.12.t: And Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica, and all who dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants of Mephibosheth.
s: And Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica, and all who dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants of Mephibosheth.

2SA.9.13.t: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table, and he was lame in both feet.
s: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table, and he was lame in both feet.

2TI.1.3.t: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.
s: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.

2TI.1.4.t: Recalling your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.
s: Recalling your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.

2TI.1.5.t: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.
s: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.

2TI.1.6.t: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
s: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

2TI.1.7.t: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
s: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

2TI.1.8.t: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.
s: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.

2TI.3.10.t: You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance,
s: You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance,

2TI.3.11.t: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
s: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.

2TI.3.12.t: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
s: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,

2TI.3.13.t: while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
s: while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

2TI.3.14.t: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.
s: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.

2TI.3.15.t: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
s: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

2TI.3.16.t: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
s: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,

2TI.3.17.t: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
s: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.

COL.3.1.t: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
s: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.

COL.3.2.t: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
s: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

COL.3.3.t: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
s: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

COL.3.4.t: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
s: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.

COL.3.8.t: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
s: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.

COL.3.9.t: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,
s: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,

COL.3.10.t: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
s: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.

COL.3.11.t: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
s: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.

COL.3.12.t: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
s: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.

COL.3.13.t: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
s: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

COL.3.14.t: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
s: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.

COL.3.15.t: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
s: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.

COL.3.16.t: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
s: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.

COL.3.17.t: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
s: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.

COL.3.22.t: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.
s: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.

COL.3.23.t: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men,
s: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men,

COL.3.24.t: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
s: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.

COL.3.25.t: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.
s: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.

COL.4.1.t: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
s: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.

DAN.6.1.t: Now it pleased Darius to appoint 120 satraps to rule throughout the kingdom,
s: Now it pleased Darius to appoint 120 satraps to rule throughout the kingdom,

DAN.6.2.t: and over them three administrators, including Daniel, to whom these satraps were accountable so that the king would not suffer loss.
s: and over them three administrators, including Daniel, to whom these satraps were accountable so that the king would not suffer loss.

DAN.6.3.t: Soon, by his extraordinary spirit, Daniel distinguished himself among the administrators and satraps. So the king planned to set him over the whole kingdom.
s: Soon, by his extraordinary spirit, Daniel distinguished himself among the administrators and satraps. So the king planned to set him over the whole kingdom.

DAN.6.4.t: Thus the administrators and satraps sought a charge against Daniel concerning the kingdom, but they could find no charge or corruption, because he was trustworthy, and no negligence or corruption was found in him.
s: Thus the administrators and satraps sought a charge against Daniel concerning the kingdom, but they could find no charge or corruption, because he was trustworthy, and no negligence or corruption was found in him.

DAN.6.5.t: Finally these men said, “We will never find any charge against this Daniel, unless we find something against him concerning the law of his God.”
s: Finally these men said, “We will never find any charge against this Daniel, unless we find something against him concerning the law of his God.”

DAN.6.6.t: So the administrators and satraps went together to the king and said, “O King Darius, may you live forever!
s: So the administrators and satraps went together to the king and said, “O King Darius, may you live forever!

DAN.6.7.t: All the royal administrators, prefects, satraps, advisers, and governors have agreed that the king should establish an ordinance and enforce a decree that for thirty days anyone who petitions any god or man except you, O king, will be thrown into the den of lions.
s: All the royal administrators, prefects, satraps, advisers, and governors have agreed that the king should establish an ordinance and enforce a decree that for thirty days anyone who petitions any god or man except you, O king, will be thrown into the den of lions.

DAN.6.8.t: Therefore, O king, establish the decree and sign the document so that it cannot be changed—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”
s: Therefore, O king, establish the decree and sign the document so that it cannot be changed—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”

DAN.6.9.t: Therefore King Darius signed the written decree.
s: Therefore King Darius signed the written decree.

DAN.6.10.t: Now when Daniel learned that the document had been signed, he went into his house, where the windows of his upper room opened toward Jerusalem, and three times a day he got down on his knees, prayed, and gave thanks to his God, just as he had done before.
s: Now when Daniel learned that the document had been signed, he went into his house, where the windows of his upper room opened toward Jerusalem, and three times a day he got down on his knees, prayed, and gave thanks to his God, just as he had done before.

DEU.6.4.t: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.
s: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.

DEU.6.5.t: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
s: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

DEU.6.6.t: These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts.
s: These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts.

DEU.6.7.t: And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
s: And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

DEU.6.8.t: Tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.
s: Tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

DEU.6.9.t: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.
s: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.

DEU.31.1.t: When Moses had finished speaking these words to all Israel,
s: When Moses had finished speaking these words to all Israel,

DEU.31.2.t: he said to them, “I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to come and go, and the LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’
s: he said to them, “I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to come and go, and the LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’

DEU.31.3.t: The LORD your God Himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will dispossess them. Joshua will cross ahead of you, as the LORD has said.
s: The LORD your God Himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will dispossess them. Joshua will cross ahead of you, as the LORD has said.

DEU.31.4.t: And the LORD will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, when He destroyed them along with their land.
s: And the LORD will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, when He destroyed them along with their land.

DEU.31.5.t: The LORD will deliver them over to you, and you must do to them exactly as I have commanded you.
s: The LORD will deliver them over to you, and you must do to them exactly as I have commanded you.

DEU.31.6.t: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”
s: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”

ECC.3.1.t: To everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
s: To everything there is a season,
and a time for every purpose under heaven:

ECC.3.2.t: a time to be born and a time to die, a time to plant and a time to uproot,
s: a time to be born and a time to die,
a time to plant and a time to uproot,

ECC.3.3.t: a time to kill and a time to heal, a time to break down and a time to build,
s: a time to kill and a time to heal,
a time to break down and a time to build,

ECC.3.4.t: a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance,
s: a time to weep and a time to laugh,
a time to mourn and a time to dance,

ECC.3.5.t: a time to cast away stones and a time to gather stones together, a time to embrace and a time to refrain from embracing,
s: a time to cast away stones and a time to gather stones together,
a time to embrace and a time to refrain from embracing,

ECC.3.6.t: a time to search and a time to count as lost, a time to keep and a time to discard,
s: a time to search and a time to count as lost,
a time to keep and a time to discard,

ECC.3.7.t: a time to tear and a time to mend, a time to be silent and a time to speak,
s: a time to tear and a time to mend,
a time to be silent and a time to speak,

ECC.3.8.t: a time to love and a time to hate, a time for war and a time for peace.
s: a time to love and a time to hate,
a time for war and a time for peace.

ECC.3.9.t: What does the worker gain from his toil?
s: What does the worker gain from his toil?

ECC.3.10.t: I have seen the burden that God has laid upon the sons of men to occupy them.
s: I have seen the burden that God has laid upon the sons of men to occupy them.

ECC.3.11.t: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
s: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.

ECC.4.7.t: Again, I saw futility under the sun.
s: Again, I saw futility under the sun.

ECC.4.8.t: There is a man all alone, without even a son or brother. And though there is no end to his labor, his eyes are still not content with his wealth: “For whom do I toil and bereave my soul of enjoyment?” This too is futile—a miserable task.
s: There is a man all alone, without even a son or brother. And though there is no end to his labor, his eyes are still not content with his wealth: “For whom do I toil and bereave my soul of enjoyment?” This too is futile—a miserable task.

ECC.4.9.t: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.
s: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.

ECC.4.10.t: For if one falls down, his companion can lift him up; but pity the one who falls without another to help him up!
s: For if one falls down, his companion can lift him up; but pity the one who falls without another to help him up!

ECC.4.11.t: Again, if two lie down together, they will keep warm; but how can one keep warm alone?
s: Again, if two lie down together, they will keep warm; but how can one keep warm alone?

ECC.4.12.t: And though one may be overpowered, two can resist. Moreover, a cord of three strands is not quickly broken.
s: And though one may be overpowered, two can resist. Moreover, a cord of three strands is not quickly broken.

ECC.9.7.t: Go, eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a cheerful heart, for God has already approved your works:
s: Go, eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a cheerful heart, for God has already approved your works:

ECC.9.8.t: Let your garments always be white, and never spare the oil for your head.
s: Let your garments always be white,
and never spare the oil for your head.

ECC.9.9.t: Enjoy life with your beloved wife all the days of the fleeting life that God has given you under the sun—all your fleeting days. For this is your portion in life and in your labor under the sun.
s: Enjoy life with your beloved wife all the days of the fleeting life that God has given you under the sun—all your fleeting days. For this is your portion in life and in your labor under the sun.

ECC.9.10.t: Whatever you find to do with your hands, do it with all your might, for in Sheol, where you are going, there is no work or planning or knowledge or wisdom.
s: Whatever you find to do with your hands, do it with all your might, for in Sheol, where you are going, there is no work or planning or knowledge or wisdom.

ECC.9.11.t: I saw something else under the sun: The race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong; neither is the bread to the wise, nor the wealth to the intelligent, nor the favor to the skillful. For time and chance happen to all.
s: I saw something else under the sun: The race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong; neither is the bread to the wise, nor the wealth to the intelligent, nor the favor to the skillful. For time and chance happen to all.

EPH.2.4.t: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
s: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,

EPH.2.5.t: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!
s: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!

EPH.2.6.t: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
s: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,

EPH.2.7.t: in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
s: in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.

EPH.2.8.t: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,
s: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,

EPH.2.9.t: not by works, so that no one can boast.
s: not by works, so that no one can boast.

EPH.2.10.t: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
s: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.

EPH.3.14.t: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,
s: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,

EPH.3.15.t: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
s: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.

EPH.3.16.t: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
s: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,

EPH.3.17.t: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
s: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,

EPH.3.18.t: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth
s: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth

EPH.3.19.t: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
s: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

EPH.3.20.t: Now to Him who is able to do so much more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
s: Now to Him who is able to do so much more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,

EPH.3.21.t: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
s: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

EPH.4.1.t: As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:
s: As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:

EPH.4.2.t: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
s: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

EPH.4.3.t: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.
s: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.

EPH.4.4.t: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;
s: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;

EPH.4.5.t: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
s: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;

EPH.4.6.t: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
s: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.

EPH.4.20.t: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.
s: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.

EPH.4.21.t: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—
s: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—

EPH.4.22.t: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
s: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;

EPH.4.23.t: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;
s: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;

EPH.4.24.t: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
s: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.

EPH.4.25.t: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
s: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.

EPH.4.29.t: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
s: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.

EPH.4.30.t: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
s: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

EPH.4.31.t: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.
s: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.

EPH.4.32.t: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
s: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.

EPH.5.1.t: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,
s: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,

EPH.5.2.t: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
s: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.

GAL.5.16.t: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
s: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

GAL.5.17.t: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.
s: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.

GAL.5.18.t: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
s: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

GAL.5.19.t: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;
s: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;

GAL.5.20.t: idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,
s: idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,

GAL.5.21.t: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
s: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.

GAL.5.22.t: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
s: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

GAL.5.23.t: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
s: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

GAL.5.24.t: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
s: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

GAL.5.25.t: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.
s: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.

GAL.5.26.t: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.
s: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.

GAL.6.1.t: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
s: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.

GAL.6.2.t: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
s: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

GAL.6.3.t: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
s: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

GAL.6.4.t: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
s: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.

GAL.6.5.t: For each one should carry his own load.
s: For each one should carry his own load.

GAL.6.6.t: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
s: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.

GAL.6.7.t: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
s: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.

GAL.6.8.t: The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
s: The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.

GAL.6.9.t: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
s: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

GAL.6.10.t: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
s: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.

HEB.4.12.t: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
s: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

HEB.4.13.t: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
s: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.

HEB.4.14.t: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
s: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.

HEB.4.15.t: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
s: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.

HEB.4.16.t: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
s: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

HEB.5.11.t: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.
s: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.

HEB.5.12.t: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!
s: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!

HEB.5.13.t: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.
s: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.

HEB.5.14.t: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.
s: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.

HEB.13.5.t: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”
s: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said:
“Never will I leave you,
never will I forsake you.”

HEB.13.6.t: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
s: So we say with confidence:
“The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid.
What can man do to me?”

HEB.13.7.t: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
s: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.

HEB.13.8.t: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
s: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

HEB.13.9.t: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.
s: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.

ISA.6.1.t: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and exalted; and the train of His robe filled the temple.
s: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and exalted; and the train of His robe filled the temple.

ISA.6.2.t: Above Him stood seraphim, each having six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.
s: Above Him stood seraphim, each having six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.

ISA.6.3.t: And they were calling out to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts; all the earth is full of His glory.”
s: And they were calling out to one another:
“Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts;
all the earth is full of His glory.”

ISA.6.4.t: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
s: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.

ISA.6.5.t: Then I said: “Woe is me, for I am ruined, because I am a man of unclean lips dwelling among a people of unclean lips; for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Hosts.”
s: Then I said:
“Woe is me,
for I am ruined,
because I am a man of unclean lips
dwelling among a people of unclean lips;
for my eyes have seen the King,
the LORD of Hosts.”

ISA.6.6.t: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, and in his hand was a glowing coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.
s: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, and in his hand was a glowing coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.

ISA.6.7.t: And with it he touched my mouth and said: “Now that this has touched your lips, your iniquity is removed and your sin is atoned for.”
s: And with it he touched my mouth and said:
“Now that this has touched your lips,
your iniquity is removed
and your sin is atoned for.”

ISA.6.8.t: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying: “Whom shall I send? Who will go for Us?” And I said: “Here am I. Send me!”
s: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying:
“Whom shall I send?
Who will go for Us?”
And I said:
“Here am I. Send me!”

ISA.26.1.t: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.
s: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah:
We have a strong city;
salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.

ISA.26.2.t: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter— one that remains faithful.
s: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter—
one that remains faithful.

ISA.26.3.t: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
s: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind,
because he trusts in You.

ISA.26.4.t: Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
s: Trust in the LORD forever,
because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.

ISA.26.5.t: For He has humbled those who dwell on high; He lays the lofty city low. He brings it down to the ground; He casts it into the dust.
s: For He has humbled those who dwell on high;
He lays the lofty city low.
He brings it down to the ground;
He casts it into the dust.

ISA.26.6.t: Feet trample it down— the feet of the oppressed, the steps of the poor.
s: Feet trample it down—
the feet of the oppressed,
the steps of the poor.

ISA.26.7.t: The path of the righteous is level; You clear a straight path for the upright.
s: The path of the righteous is level;
You clear a straight path for the upright.

ISA.26.8.t: Yes, we wait for You, O LORD; we walk in the path of Your judgments. Your name and renown are the desire of our souls.
s: Yes, we wait for You, O LORD;
we walk in the path of Your judgments.
Your name and renown
are the desire of our souls.

ISA.26.9.t: My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
s: My soul longs for You in the night;
indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn.
For when Your judgments come upon the earth,
the people of the world learn righteousness.

ISA.40.27.t: Why do you say, O Jacob, and why do you assert, O Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and my claim is ignored by my God”?
s: Why do you say, O Jacob,
and why do you assert, O Israel,
“My way is hidden from the LORD,
and my claim is ignored by my God”?

ISA.40.28.t: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out.
s: Do you not know?
Have you not heard?
The LORD is the everlasting God,
the Creator of the ends of the earth.
He will not grow tired or weary;
His understanding is beyond searching out.

ISA.40.29.t: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.
s: He gives power to the faint
and increases the strength of the weak.

ISA.40.30.t: Even youths grow tired and weary, and young men stumble and fall.
s: Even youths grow tired and weary,
and young men stumble and fall.

ISA.40.31.t: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
s: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength;
they will mount up with wings like eagles;
they will run and not grow weary,
they will walk and not faint.

ISA.41.8.t: “But you, O Israel, My servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, descendant of Abraham My friend—
s: “But you, O Israel, My servant,
Jacob, whom I have chosen,
descendant of Abraham My friend—

ISA.41.9.t: I brought you from the ends of the earth and called you from its farthest corners. I said, ‘You are My servant.’ I have chosen and not rejected you.
s: I brought you from the ends of the earth
and called you from its farthest corners.
I said, ‘You are My servant.’
I have chosen and not rejected you.

ISA.41.10.t: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.
s: Do not fear, for I am with you;
do not be afraid, for I am your God.
I will strengthen you; I will surely help you;
I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.
