ISA.41.11.t: Behold, all who rage against you will be ashamed and disgraced; those who contend with you will be reduced to nothing and will perish.
s: Behold, all who rage against you
will be ashamed and disgraced;
those who contend with you
will be reduced to nothing and will perish.

ISA.41.12.t: You will seek them but will not find them. Those who wage war against you will come to nothing.
s: You will seek them but will not find them.
Those who wage war against you will come to nothing.

ISA.41.13.t: For I am the LORD your God, who takes hold of your right hand and tells you: Do not fear, I will help you.
s: For I am the LORD your God,
who takes hold of your right hand
and tells you: Do not fear,
I will help you.

ISA.43.1.t: Now this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
s: Now this is what the LORD says—
He who created you, O Jacob,
and He who formed you, O Israel:
“Do not fear, for I have redeemed you;
I have called you by your name; you are Mine!

ISA.43.2.t: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.
s: When you pass through the waters,
I will be with you;
and when you go through the rivers,
they will not overwhelm you.
When you walk through the fire,
you will not be scorched;
the flames will not set you ablaze.

ISA.43.3.t: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.
s: For I am the LORD your God,
the Holy One of Israel, your Savior;
I give Egypt for your ransom,
Cush and Seba in your place.

ISA.43.4.t: Because you are precious and honored in My sight, and because I love you, I will give men in exchange for you and nations in place of your life.
s: Because you are precious and honored in My sight,
and because I love you,
I will give men in exchange for you
and nations in place of your life.

ISA.43.5.t: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east and gather you from the west.
s: Do not be afraid, for I am with you;
I will bring your offspring from the east
and gather you from the west.

ISA.43.6.t: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth—
s: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’
and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’
Bring My sons from afar,
and My daughters from the ends of the earth—

ISA.43.7.t: everyone called by My name and created for My glory, whom I have indeed formed and made.”
s: everyone called by My name and created for My glory,
whom I have indeed formed and made.”

ISA.43.16.t: Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea and a path through the surging waters,
s: Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea
and a path through the surging waters,

ISA.43.17.t: who brings out the chariots and horses, the armies and warriors together, to lie down, never to rise again; to be extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:
s: who brings out the chariots and horses,
the armies and warriors together,
to lie down, never to rise again;
to be extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:

ISA.43.18.t: “Do not call to mind the former things; pay no attention to the things of old.
s: “Do not call to mind the former things;
pay no attention to the things of old.

ISA.43.19.t: Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
s: Behold, I am about to do something new;
even now it is coming. Do you not see it?
Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness
and streams in the desert.

ISA.43.20.t: The beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to My chosen people.
s: The beasts of the field will honor Me,
the jackals and the ostriches,
because I provide water in the wilderness
and rivers in the desert,
to give drink to My chosen people.

ISA.43.21.t: The people I formed for Myself will declare My praise.
s: The people I formed for Myself
will declare My praise.

JAS.1.2.t: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
s: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,

JAS.1.3.t: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.
s: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.

JAS.1.4.t: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
s: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

JAS.1.5.t: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
s: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.

JAS.1.6.t: But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
s: But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.

JAS.1.7.t: That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
s: That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.

JAS.1.8.t: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
s: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

JAS.1.12.t: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
s: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.

JAS.1.13.t: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.
s: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.

JAS.1.14.t: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.
s: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.

JAS.1.15.t: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
s: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.

JAS.1.16.t: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.
s: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.

JAS.1.17.t: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
s: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.

JAS.1.18.t: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation.
s: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation.

JAS.1.19.t: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
s: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,

JAS.1.20.t: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
s: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.

JAS.1.21.t: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
s: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.

JAS.1.22.t: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
s: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.

JAS.1.23.t: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
s: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,

JAS.1.24.t: and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.
s: and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.

JAS.1.25.t: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.
s: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.

JAS.1.26.t: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.
s: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.

JAS.1.27.t: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
s: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.

JAS.4.1.t: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?
s: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?

JAS.4.2.t: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
s: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.

JAS.4.3.t: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
s: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.

JAS.4.4.t: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
s: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.

JAS.4.5.t: Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?
s: Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?

JAS.4.6.t: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
s: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says:
“God opposes the proud,
but gives grace to the humble.”

JAS.4.7.t: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
s: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

JAS.4.8.t: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
s: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

JAS.4.9.t: Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
s: Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.

JAS.4.10.t: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
s: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.

JER.1.4.t: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
s: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:

JER.1.5.t: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I set you apart and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”
s: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you,
and before you were born I set you apart
and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”

JER.1.6.t: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!”
s: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!”

JER.1.7.t: But the LORD told me: “Do not say, ‘I am only a child.’ For to everyone I send you, you must go, and all that I command you, you must speak.
s: But the LORD told me:
“Do not say,
‘I am only a child.’
For to everyone I send you,
you must go,
and all that I command you,
you must speak.

JER.1.8.t: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
s: Do not be afraid of them,
for I am with you to deliver you,”
declares the LORD.

JER.1.9.t: Then the LORD reached out His hand, touched my mouth, and said to me: “Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
s: Then the LORD reached out His hand, touched my mouth, and said to me:
“Behold, I have put My words
in your mouth.

JER.1.10.t: See, I have appointed you today over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and plant.”
s: See, I have appointed you today
over nations and kingdoms
to uproot and tear down,
to destroy and overthrow,
to build and plant.”

JER.17.5.t: This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes the flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
s: This is what the LORD says:
“Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind,
who makes the flesh his strength
and turns his heart from the LORD.

JER.17.6.t: He will be like a shrub in the desert; he will not see when prosperity comes. He will dwell in the parched places of the desert, in a salt land where no one lives.
s: He will be like a shrub in the desert;
he will not see when prosperity comes.
He will dwell in the parched places of the desert,
in a salt land where no one lives.

JER.17.7.t: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
s: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD,
whose confidence is in Him.

JER.17.8.t: He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots toward the stream. It does not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves are always green. It does not worry in a year of drought, nor does it cease to produce fruit.
s: He is like a tree planted by the waters
that sends out its roots toward the stream.
It does not fear when the heat comes,
and its leaves are always green.
It does not worry in a year of drought,
nor does it cease to produce fruit.

JER.29.4.t: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles who were carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon:
s: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles who were carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon:

JER.29.5.t: “Build houses and settle down. Plant gardens and eat their produce.
s: “Build houses and settle down. Plant gardens and eat their produce.

JER.29.6.t: Take wives and have sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Multiply there; do not decrease.
s: Take wives and have sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Multiply there; do not decrease.

JER.29.7.t: Seek the prosperity of the city to which I have sent you as exiles. Pray to the LORD on its behalf, for if it prospers, you too will prosper.”
s: Seek the prosperity of the city to which I have sent you as exiles. Pray to the LORD on its behalf, for if it prospers, you too will prosper.”

JER.29.8.t: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Do not be deceived by the prophets and diviners among you, and do not listen to the dreams you elicit from them.
s: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Do not be deceived by the prophets and diviners among you, and do not listen to the dreams you elicit from them.

JER.29.9.t: For they are falsely prophesying to you in My name; I have not sent them, declares the LORD.”
s: For they are falsely prophesying to you in My name; I have not sent them, declares the LORD.”

JER.29.10.t: For this is what the LORD says: “When Babylon’s seventy years are complete, I will attend to you and confirm My promise to restore you to this place.
s: For this is what the LORD says: “When Babylon’s seventy years are complete, I will attend to you and confirm My promise to restore you to this place.

JER.29.11.t: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.
s: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.

JER.29.12.t: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
s: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.

JER.29.13.t: You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
s: You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.

JER.29.14.t: I will be found by you, declares the LORD, and I will restore you from captivity and gather you from all the nations and places to which I have banished you, declares the LORD. I will restore you to the place from which I sent you into exile.”
s: I will be found by you, declares the LORD, and I will restore you from captivity and gather you from all the nations and places to which I have banished you, declares the LORD. I will restore you to the place from which I sent you into exile.”
“How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.

JHN.3.10.t: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?
s: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?

JHN.3.11.t: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.
s: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.

JHN.3.12.t: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
s: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?

JHN.3.13.t: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.
s: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.

JHN.3.14.t: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
s: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,

JHN.3.15.t: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
s: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.

JHN.3.16.t: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
s: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.

JHN.3.17.t: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
s: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.

JHN.6.35.t: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
s: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.

JHN.6.36.t: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.
s: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.

JHN.6.37.t: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
s: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.

JHN.6.38.t: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
s: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.

JHN.6.39.t: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
s: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.

JHN.6.40.t: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
s: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”

JHN.11.32.t: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
s: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”

JHN.11.33.t: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
s: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

JHN.11.34.t: “Where have you put him?” He asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they answered.
s: “Where have you put him?” He asked.
“Come and see, Lord,” they answered.
Jesus wept.

JHN.11.36.t: Then the Jews said, “See how He loved him!”
s: Then the Jews said, “See how He loved him!”

JHN.11.37.t: But some of them asked, “Could not this man who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept Lazarus from dying?”
s: But some of them asked, “Could not this man who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept Lazarus from dying?”

JHN.13.1.t: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.
s: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.

JHN.13.2.t: The evening meal was underway, and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
s: The evening meal was underway, and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.

JHN.13.3.t: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
s: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.

JHN.13.4.t: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.
s: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.

JHN.13.5.t: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.
s: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.

JHN.13.6.t: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”
s: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”

JHN.13.7.t: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
s: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”

JHN.13.8.t: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him. Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”
s: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him.
Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”

JHN.13.9.t: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”
s: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”

JHN.13.10.t: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
s: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”

JHN.13.11.t: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”
s: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”

JHN.13.12.t: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again and asked, “Do you know what I have done for you?
s: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again and asked, “Do you know what I have done for you?

JHN.13.13.t: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.
s: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.

JHN.13.14.t: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
s: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.

JHN.13.15.t: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.
s: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.

JHN.14.25.t: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.
s: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.

JHN.14.26.t: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
s: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.

JHN.14.27.t: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
s: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

JHN.14.28.t: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
s: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

JHN.14.29.t: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.
s: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.

JHN.14.30.t: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.
s: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.

JHN.14.31.t: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.
s: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father.
Get up! Let us go on from here.

JHN.15.9.t: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.
s: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.

JHN.15.10.t: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
s: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.

JHN.15.11.t: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
s: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.

JHN.15.12.t: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
s: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

JHN.15.13.t: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
s: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.

JHN.15.14.t: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
s: You are My friends if you do what I command you.

JHN.15.15.t: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
s: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.

JHN.15.16.t: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
s: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

JHN.15.17.t: This is My command to you: Love one another.
s: This is My command to you: Love one another.

JHN.20.24.t: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
s: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.

JHN.20.25.t: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”
s: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!”
But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”

JHN.20.26.t: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
s: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”

JHN.20.27.t: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”
s: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”

JHN.20.28.t: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”
s: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”

JHN.20.29.t: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
s: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”

JHN.20.30.t: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.
s: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.

JHN.20.31.t: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
s: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.

JHN.21.9.t: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.
s: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.

JHN.21.10.t: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
s: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”

JHN.21.11.t: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.
s: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.

JHN.21.12.t: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.
s: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.

JHN.21.13.t: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.
s: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.

JHN.21.14.t: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.
s: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.

JHN.21.15.t: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”
s: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?”
“Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.”
Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”

JHN.21.16.t: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”
s: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?”
“Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.”
Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”

JHN.21.17.t: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.
s: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?”
Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?”
“Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.”
Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.

JOS.1.1.t: Now after the death of His servant Moses, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying,
s: Now after the death of His servant Moses, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying,

JOS.1.2.t: “Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, you and all these people, and cross over the Jordan into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel.
s: “Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, you and all these people, and cross over the Jordan into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel.

JOS.1.3.t: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.
s: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.

MAT.5.8.t: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
s: Blessed are the pure in heart,
for they will see God.

MAT.5.9.t: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
s: Blessed are the peacemakers,
for they will be called sons of God.

MAT.5.10.t: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
s: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness,
for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

MAT.5.11.t: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
s: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.

MAT.5.12.t: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven; for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.
s: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven; for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.

s: “Be careful not to perform your righteous acts before men to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.

MAT.6.2.t: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
s: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.

MAT.6.3.t: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
s: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,

MAT.6.4.t: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
s: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

MAT.6.5.t: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
s: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.

MAT.6.6.t: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
s: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

MAT.6.9.t: So then, this is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.
s: So then, this is how you should pray:
‘Our Father in heaven,
hallowed be Your name.

MAT.6.10.t: Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
s: Your kingdom come,
Your will be done,
on earth as it is in heaven.

MAT.6.11.t: Give us this day our daily bread.
s: Give us this day our daily bread.

MAT.6.12.t: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
s: And forgive us our debts,
as we also have forgiven our debtors.

MAT.6.13.t: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’
s: And lead us not into temptation,
but deliver us from the evil one.’

MAT.6.14.t: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
s: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

MAT.6.15.t: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours.
s: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours.

MAT.6.25.t: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
s: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?

MAT.6.26.t: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns—and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
s: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns—and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?

MAT.6.27.t: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
s: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?

MAT.6.28.t: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.
s: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.

MAT.6.29.t: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
s: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.

MAT.6.30.t: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
s: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?

MAT.6.31.t: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’
s: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’

MAT.6.32.t: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
s: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.

MAT.6.33.t: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
s: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.

MAT.6.34.t: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
s: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.

MAT.7.7.t: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
s: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.

MAT.7.8.t: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.

MAT.7.9.t: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?
s: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?

MAT.7.10.t: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
s: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?

MAT.7.11.t: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
s: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!

MAT.10.29.t: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
s: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.

MAT.11.25.t: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
s: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.

MAT.11.26.t: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
s: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.

MAT.11.27.t: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
s: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.

MAT.11.28.t: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
s: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

MAT.11.29.t: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
s: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

MAT.11.30.t: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
s: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”

MAT.18.15.t: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
s: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.

MAT.18.16.t: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
s: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’

MAT.18.17.t: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
s: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.

MAT.18.18.t: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
s: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

MAT.18.19.t: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
s: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.

MAT.18.20.t: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”
s: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”

s: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?”

MAT.18.22.t: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!
s: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!

MIC.6.1.t: Hear now what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
s: Hear now what the LORD says:
“Arise, plead your case before the mountains,
and let the hills hear your voice.

MIC.6.2.t: Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against His people, and He will argue it against Israel:
s: Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment,
you enduring foundations of the earth.
For the LORD has a case against His people,
and He will argue it against Israel:

MIC.6.3.t: ‘My people, what have I done to you? Testify against Me how I have wearied you!
s: ‘My people, what have I done to you?
Testify against Me how I have wearied you!

MIC.6.4.t: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery. I sent Moses before you, as well as Aaron and Miriam.
s: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt
and redeemed you from the house of slavery.
I sent Moses before you,
as well as Aaron and Miriam.

MIC.6.5.t: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of the LORD.’”
s: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled
and what Balaam son of Beor answered.
Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal,
so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of the LORD.’”

MIC.6.6.t: With what shall I come before the LORD when I bow before the God on high? Should I come to Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?
s: With what shall I come before the LORD
when I bow before the God on high?
Should I come to Him with burnt offerings,
with year-old calves?

MIC.6.7.t: Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
s: Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams,
with ten thousand rivers of oil?
Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression,
the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

MIC.6.8.t: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
s: He has shown you, O man, what is good.
And what does the LORD require of you
but to act justly, to love mercy,
and to walk humbly with your God?

MRK.10.13.t: Now people were bringing the little children to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them, and the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
s: Now people were bringing the little children to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them, and the disciples rebuked those who brought them.

MRK.10.14.t: But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant and told them, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
s: But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant and told them, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

MRK.10.15.t: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”
s: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”

MRK.10.16.t: And He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them.
s: And He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them.

MRK.10.35.t: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus and declared, “Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask.”
s: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus and declared, “Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask.”

MRK.10.36.t: “What do you want Me to do for you?” He inquired.
s: “What do you want Me to do for you?” He inquired.

MRK.10.37.t: They answered, “Grant that one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your glory.”
s: They answered, “Grant that one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your glory.”

MRK.10.38.t: “You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I will drink, or be baptized with the baptism I will undergo?”
s: “You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I will drink, or be baptized with the baptism I will undergo?”

MRK.10.39.t: “We can,” the brothers answered. “You will drink the cup that I drink,” Jesus said, “and you will be baptized with the baptism that I undergo.
s: “We can,” the brothers answered.
“You will drink the cup that I drink,” Jesus said, “and you will be baptized with the baptism that I undergo.

MRK.10.40.t: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”
s: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”

MRK.10.41.t: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.
s: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.

MRK.10.42.t: So Jesus called them together and said, “You know that those regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
s: So Jesus called them together and said, “You know that those regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.

MRK.10.43.t: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
s: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

MRK.10.44.t: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
s: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.

MRK.10.45.t: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
s: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”

NUM.6.24.t: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you;
s: ‘May the LORD bless you
and keep you;

NUM.6.25.t: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you;
s: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you
and be gracious to you;

NUM.6.26.t: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’
s: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you
and give you peace.’

PHP.1.3.t: I thank my God every time I remember you.
s: I thank my God every time I remember you.

PHP.1.4.t: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,
s: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,

PHP.1.5.t: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
s: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,

s: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

s: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.

PHP.1.8.t: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
s: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.

PHP.1.9.t: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
s: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,

PHP.1.10.t: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
s: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,

PHP.1.11.t: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
s: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

PHP.2.1.t: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,

PHP.2.2.t: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.
s: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.

PHP.2.3.t: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.
s: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.

PHP.2.4.t: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.
s: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.

PHP.2.5.t: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:
s: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:

PHP.2.6.t: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,
s: Who, existing in the form of God,
did not consider equality with God
something to be grasped,

PHP.2.7.t: but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.
s: but emptied Himself,
taking the form of a servant,
being made in human likeness.

s: And being found in appearance as a man,
He humbled Himself
and became obedient to death—
even death on a cross.

PHP.2.9.t: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,
s: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place
and gave Him the name above all names,

PHP.2.10.t: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
s: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow,
in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

PHP.2.11.t: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
s: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord,
to the glory of God the Father.

PHP.4.4.t: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
s: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

PHP.4.5.t: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.
s: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.

s: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

s: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

s: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.

s: These are the proverbs of Solomon son of David,
king of Israel,

PRO.1.2.t: for gaining wisdom and discipline, for comprehending words of insight,
s: for gaining wisdom and discipline,
for comprehending words of insight,

PRO.1.3.t: and for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness, justice, and equity.
s: and for receiving instruction in wise living
and in righteousness, justice, and equity.

s: To impart prudence to the simple
and knowledge and discretion to the young,

s: let the wise listen and gain instruction,
and the discerning acquire wise counsel

s: by understanding the proverbs and parables,
the sayings and riddles of the wise.

s: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge,
but fools despise wisdom and discipline.

s: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction,
and do not forsake the teaching of your mother.

s: For they are a garland of grace on your head
and a pendant around your neck.

s: My son, if you accept my words
and hide my commandments within you,

PRO.2.2.t: if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding,
s: if you incline your ear to wisdom
and direct your heart to understanding,

PRO.2.3.t: if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding,
s: if you truly call out to insight
and lift your voice to understanding,

PRO.2.4.t: if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure,
s: if you seek it like silver
and search it out like hidden treasure,

PRO.2.5.t: then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.
s: then you will discern the fear of the LORD
and discover the knowledge of God.

PRO.2.6.t: For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
s: For the LORD gives wisdom;
from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

PRO.2.7.t: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,
s: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright;
He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,

PRO.2.8.t: to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints.
s: to guard the paths of justice
and protect the way of His saints.

PRO.2.9.t: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity—every good path.
s: Then you will discern righteousness
and justice and equity—every good path.

PRO.2.10.t: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will delight your soul.
s: For wisdom will enter your heart,
and knowledge will delight your soul.

PRO.2.11.t: Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you,
s: Discretion will watch over you,
and understanding will guard you,

s: My son, do not forget my teaching,
but let your heart keep my commandments;

PRO.3.2.t: for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.
s: for they will add length to your days,
years and peace to your life.

s: Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you;
bind them around your neck,
write them on the tablet of your heart.

PRO.3.4.t: Then you will find favor and high regard in the sight of God and man.
s: Then you will find favor and high regard
in the sight of God and man.

PRO.3.5.t: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
s: Trust in the LORD with all your heart,
and lean not on your own understanding;

PRO.3.6.t: in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
s: in all your ways acknowledge Him,
and He will make your paths straight.

PRO.3.7.t: Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
s: Be not wise in your own eyes;
fear the LORD and turn away from evil.

PRO.3.8.t: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones.
s: This will bring healing to your body
and refreshment to your bones.

s: Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction;
pay attention and gain understanding.

PRO.4.2.t: For I give you sound teaching; do not abandon my directive.
s: For I give you sound teaching;
do not abandon my directive.

PRO.4.3.t: When I was a son to my father, tender and the only child of my mother,
s: When I was a son to my father,
tender and the only child of my mother,

s: he taught me and said,
“Let your heart lay hold of my words;
keep my commands and you will live.

PRO.4.5.t: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn from them.
s: Get wisdom, get understanding;
do not forget my words or turn from them.

s: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will preserve you;
love her, and she will guard you.

And whatever you may acquire, gain understanding.

if you embrace her, she will honor you.

she will present you with a crown of beauty.”

s: My son, pay attention to my words;
incline your ear to my sayings.

PRO.4.21.t: Do not lose sight of them; keep them within your heart.
s: Do not lose sight of them;
keep them within your heart.

s: For they are life to those who find them,
and health to the whole body.

PRO.4.23.t: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
s: Guard your heart with all diligence,
for from it flow springs of life.

PRO.4.24.t: Put away deception from your mouth; keep your lips from perverse speech.
s: Put away deception from your mouth;
keep your lips from perverse speech.

PRO.4.25.t: Let your eyes look forward; fix your gaze straight ahead.
s: Let your eyes look forward;
fix your gaze straight ahead.

PRO.4.26.t: Make a level path for your feet, and all your ways will be sure.
s: Make a level path for your feet,
and all your ways will be sure.

PRO.4.27.t: Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your feet away from evil.

turn your feet away from evil.

observe its ways and become wise.

without an overseer or ruler,

it gathers its food at harvest.

s: A little sleep, a little slumber,
a little folding of the hands to rest,

and need like a bandit.

PRO.9.1.t: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars.
s: Wisdom has built her house;
she has carved out her seven pillars.

she has also set her table.

s: She has sent out her maidservants;
she calls out from the heights of the city.

s: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!”
she says to him who lacks judgment.

and drink the wine I have mixed.

s: Leave your folly behind, and you will live;
walk in the way of understanding.”

s: He who corrects a mocker brings shame on himself;
he who rebukes a wicked man taints himself.

s: Do not rebuke a mocker, or he will hate you;
rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.

s: Instruct a wise man, and he will be wiser still;
teach a righteous man, and he will increase his learning.

PRO.9.10.t: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
s: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom,
and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

PRO.9.11.t: For through wisdom your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.
s: For through wisdom your days will be multiplied,
and years will be added to your life.

PRO.9.12.t: If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage; but if you scoff, you alone will bear the consequences.
s: If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage;
but if you scoff, you alone will bear the consequences.

PRO.10.1.t: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.
s: The proverbs of Solomon:
A wise son brings joy to his father,
but a foolish son grief to his mother.

PRO.10.2.t: Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
s: Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing,
but righteousness brings deliverance from death.

PRO.10.3.t: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.
s: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry,
but He denies the craving of the wicked.

PRO.10.4.t: Idle hands make one poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.
s: Idle hands make one poor,
but diligent hands bring wealth.

PRO.10.5.t: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.
s: He who gathers in summer is a wise son,
but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.

PRO.10.6.t: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
s: Blessings are on the head of the righteous,
but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

PRO.10.7.t: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
s: The memory of the righteous is a blessing,
but the name of the wicked will rot.

PRO.10.8.t: A wise heart will receive commandments, but foolish lips will come to ruin.
s: A wise heart will receive commandments,
but foolish lips will come to ruin.

PRO.10.9.t: He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
s: He who walks in integrity walks securely,
but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

PRO.11.9.t: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.
s: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor,
but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.

PRO.11.10.t: When the righteous thrive, the city rejoices, and when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
s: When the righteous thrive, the city rejoices,
and when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.

PRO.11.11.t: By the blessing of the upright a city is built up, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
s: By the blessing of the upright a city is built up,
but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.

PRO.11.12.t: Whoever shows contempt for his neighbor lacks judgment, but a man of understanding remains silent.
s: Whoever shows contempt for his neighbor lacks judgment,
but a man of understanding remains silent.

PRO.11.13.t: A gossip reveals a secret, but a trustworthy person keeps a confidence.
s: A gossip reveals a secret,
but a trustworthy person keeps a confidence.

PRO.11.14.t: For lack of guidance, a nation falls, but with many counselors comes deliverance.
s: For lack of guidance, a nation falls,
but with many counselors comes deliverance.

PRO.12.17.t: He who speaks the truth declares what is right, but a false witness speaks deceit.
s: He who speaks the truth declares what is right,
but a false witness speaks deceit.

PRO.12.18.t: Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
s: Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword,
but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

PRO.12.19.t: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
s: Truthful lips endure forever,
but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.

PRO.12.20.t: Deceit is in the hearts of those who devise evil, but the counselors of peace have joy.
s: Deceit is in the hearts of those who devise evil,
but the counselors of peace have joy.

PRO.12.21.t: No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked are filled with trouble.
s: No harm befalls the righteous,
but the wicked are filled with trouble.

PRO.12.22.t: Lying lips are detestable to the LORD, but those who deal faithfully are His delight.
s: Lying lips are detestable to the LORD,
but those who deal faithfully are His delight.

PRO.13.14.t: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning one from the snares of death.
s: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life,
turning one from the snares of death.

PRO.13.15.t: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the faithless is difficult.
s: Good understanding wins favor,
but the way of the faithless is difficult.

PRO.13.16.t: Every prudent man acts with knowledge, but a fool displays his folly.
s: Every prudent man acts with knowledge,
but a fool displays his folly.

PRO.13.17.t: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a faithful envoy brings healing.
s: A wicked messenger falls into trouble,
but a faithful envoy brings healing.

PRO.13.18.t: Poverty and shame come to him who ignores discipline, but whoever heeds correction is honored.
s: Poverty and shame come to him who ignores discipline,
but whoever heeds correction is honored.

PRO.13.19.t: Desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but turning from evil is detestable to fools.
s: Desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul,
but turning from evil is detestable to fools.

PRO.13.20.t: He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
s: He who walks with the wise will become wise,
but the companion of fools will be destroyed.

PRO.15.1.t: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
s: A gentle answer turns away wrath,
but a harsh word stirs up anger.

PRO.15.2.t: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool spouts folly.
s: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge,
but the mouth of the fool spouts folly.

PRO.15.3.t: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, observing the evil and the good.
s: The eyes of the LORD are in every place,
observing the evil and the good.

PRO.15.4.t: A soothing tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.
s: A soothing tongue is a tree of life,
but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.

PRO.16.1.t: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the reply of the tongue is from the LORD.
s: The plans of the heart belong to man,
but the reply of the tongue is from the LORD.

PRO.16.2.t: All a man’s ways are pure in his own eyes, but his motives are weighed out by the LORD.
s: All a man’s ways are pure in his own eyes,
but his motives are weighed out by the LORD.

PRO.16.3.t: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
s: Commit your works to the LORD
and your plans will be achieved.

PRO.16.4.t: The LORD has made everything for His purpose— even the wicked for the day of disaster.
s: The LORD has made everything for His purpose—
even the wicked for the day of disaster.

PRO.16.5.t: Everyone who is proud in heart is detestable to the LORD; be assured that he will not go unpunished.
s: Everyone who is proud in heart is detestable to the LORD;
be assured that he will not go unpunished.

PRO.16.6.t: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from evil.
s: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for,
and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from evil.

PRO.16.7.t: When a man’s ways please the LORD, He makes even the man’s enemies live at peace with him.
s: When a man’s ways please the LORD,
He makes even the man’s enemies live at peace with him.

PRO.16.8.t: Better a little with righteousness than great gain with injustice.
s: Better a little with righteousness
than great gain with injustice.

PRO.16.9.t: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
s: A man’s heart plans his course,
but the LORD determines his steps.

PRO.16.21.t: The wise in heart are called discerning, and pleasant speech promotes instruction.
s: The wise in heart are called discerning,
and pleasant speech promotes instruction.

PRO.16.22.t: Understanding is a fountain of life to its possessor, but the discipline of fools is folly.
s: Understanding is a fountain of life to its possessor,
but the discipline of fools is folly.

PRO.16.23.t: The heart of the wise man instructs his mouth and adds persuasiveness to his lips.
s: The heart of the wise man instructs his mouth
and adds persuasiveness to his lips.

PRO.16.24.t: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.
s: Pleasant words are a honeycomb,
sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.

PRO.16.27.t: A worthless man digs up evil, and his speech is like a scorching fire.
s: A worthless man digs up evil,
and his speech is like a scorching fire.

PRO.16.28.t: A perverse man spreads dissension, and a gossip divides close friends.
s: A perverse man spreads dissension,
and a gossip divides close friends.

s: A violent man entices his neighbor

s: He who winks his eye devises perversity;
he who purses his lips is bent on evil.

it is attained along the path of righteousness.

s: He who is slow to anger is better than a warrior,
and he who controls his temper is greater than one who captures a city.

PRO.17.9.t: Whoever conceals an offense promotes love, but he who brings it up separates friends.
s: Whoever conceals an offense promotes love,
but he who brings it up separates friends.

PRO.17.10.t: A rebuke cuts into a man of discernment deeper than a hundred lashes cut into a fool.
s: A rebuke cuts into a man of discernment
deeper than a hundred lashes cut into a fool.

PRO.17.11.t: An evil man seeks only rebellion; a cruel messenger will be sent against him.
s: An evil man seeks only rebellion;
a cruel messenger will be sent against him.

so abandon the dispute before it breaks out.

s: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the righteous—
both are detestable to the LORD.

s: Why should the fool have money in his hand
with no intention of buying wisdom?

s: A friend loves at all times,
and a brother is born for adversity.

better to be poor than a liar.

that one may rest content, without visitation from harm.

favor is better than silver and gold.

and do not let your heart rejoice when he stumbles,

and turn His wrath away from him.

s: Better an open rebuke
than love that is concealed.

s: The wounds of a friend are faithful,
but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

s: Oil and incense bring joy to the heart,
and the sweetness of a friend is counsel to the soul.

and do not go to your brother’s house
in the day of your calamity;
better a neighbor nearby
than a brother far away.

s: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart,
so that I can answer him who taunts me.

s: The prudent see danger and take cover;
but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.

s: Take the garment of him who posts security for a stranger;
get collateral if it is for a foreigner.

and a contentious woman are alike—

s: As iron sharpens iron,
so one man sharpens another.

What, O son of my womb?
What, O son of my vows?

s: Do not spend your strength on women

it is not for kings to drink wine,

depriving all the oppressed of justice.

s: Give strong drink to one who is perishing,

s: Let him drink and forget his poverty,

for the cause of all the dispossessed.

her husband praises her as well:

s: “Many daughters have done noble things,

s: Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting,
but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.

and let her works praise her at the gates.

s: O LORD, how my foes have increased!
How many rise up against me!

s: Many say of me,
“God will not deliver him.”
Selah

s: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me,
my glory, and the One who lifts my head.

s: To the LORD I cry aloud,
and He answers me from His holy mountain.
Selah

s: I lie down and sleep;
I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.

s: I will not fear the myriads
set against me on every side.

s: Arise, O LORD!
Save me, O my God!
Strike all my enemies on the jaw;
break the teeth of the wicked.

s: Salvation belongs to the LORD;
may Your blessing be on Your people.
Selah

He has established His throne for judgment.

He governs the people with equity.

s: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed,
a stronghold in times of trouble.

for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.

s: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion;
proclaim His deeds among the nations.

He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.

Do not forget the helpless.
