The victim entrusts himself to You;
You are the helper of the fatherless.

PSA.10.15.t: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.
s: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer;
call him to account for his wickedness
until none is left to be found.

PSA.10.16.t: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
s: The LORD is King forever and ever;
the nations perish from His land.

PSA.10.17.t: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,
s: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble;
You will strengthen their hearts.
You will incline Your ear,

PSA.10.18.t: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.
s: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed,
that the men of the earth
may strike terror no more.

PSA.16.1.t: Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.
s: Preserve me, O God,
for in You I take refuge.

PSA.16.2.t: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”
s: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord;
apart from You I have no good thing.”

PSA.16.3.t: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.
s: As for the saints in the land,
they are the excellence
in whom all my delight resides.

PSA.16.4.t: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.
s: Sorrows will multiply
to those who chase other gods.
I will not pour out their libations of blood,
or speak their names with my lips.

PSA.16.5.t: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.
s: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup;
You have made my lot secure.

PSA.16.6.t: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.
s: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places;
surely my inheritance is delightful.

PSA.16.7.t: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.
s: I will bless the LORD who counsels me;
even at night my conscience instructs me.

PSA.16.8.t: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
s: I have set the LORD always before me.
Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

PSA.16.9.t: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
s: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices;
my body also will dwell securely.

PSA.16.10.t: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
s: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol,
nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.

PSA.16.11.t: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
s: You have made known to me the path of life;
You will fill me with joy in Your presence,
with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.

PSA.23.1.t: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
s: The LORD is my shepherd;
I shall not want.

PSA.23.2.t: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
s: He makes me lie down in green pastures;
He leads me beside quiet waters.

PSA.23.3.t: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
s: He restores my soul;
He guides me in the paths of righteousness
for the sake of His name.

PSA.23.4.t: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
s: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
I will fear no evil,
for You are with me;
Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

PSA.23.5.t: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
s: You prepare a table before me
in the presence of my enemies.
You anoint my head with oil;
my cup overflows.

PSA.23.6.t: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
s: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me
all the days of my life,
and I will dwell in the house of the LORD
forever.

PSA.25.1.t: To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;
s: To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;

PSA.25.2.t: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
s: in You, my God, I trust.
Do not let me be put to shame;
do not let my enemies exult over me.

PSA.25.3.t: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who are faithless without cause will be disgraced.
s: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame;
but those who are faithless without cause will be disgraced.

PSA.25.4.t: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
s: Show me Your ways, O LORD;
teach me Your paths.

PSA.25.5.t: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
s: Guide me in Your truth and teach me,
for You are the God of my salvation;
all day long I wait for You.

PSA.25.6.t: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.
s: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion,
for they are from age to age.

PSA.25.7.t: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.
s: Remember not the sins of my youth,
nor my rebellious acts;
remember me according to Your loving devotion,
because of Your goodness, O LORD.

PSA.25.8.t: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
s: Good and upright is the LORD;
therefore He shows sinners the way.

PSA.25.9.t: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.
s: He guides the humble in what is right
and teaches them His way.

PSA.25.10.t: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.
s: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful
to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.

PSA.25.14.t: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
s: The LORD confides in those who fear Him,
and reveals His covenant to them.

PSA.25.15.t: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
s: My eyes are always on the LORD,
for He will free my feet from the mesh.

PSA.25.16.t: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
s: Turn to me and be gracious,
for I am lonely and afflicted.

PSA.25.17.t: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
s: The troubles of my heart increase;
free me from my distress.

PSA.25.18.t: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
s: Consider my affliction and trouble,
and take away all my sins.

PSA.25.19.t: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.
s: Consider my enemies, for they are many,
and they hate me with vicious hatred.

PSA.25.20.t: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.
s: Guard my soul and deliver me;
let me not be put to shame,
for I take refuge in You.

PSA.25.21.t: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
s: May integrity and uprightness preserve me,
because I wait for You.

PSA.27.1.t: The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
s: The LORD is my light and my salvation—
whom shall I fear?
The LORD is the stronghold of my life—
whom shall I dread?

PSA.27.2.t: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.
s: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh,
my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.

PSA.27.3.t: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
s: Though an army encamps around me,
my heart will not fear;
though a war breaks out against me,
I will keep my trust.

PSA.27.4.t: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
s: One thing I have asked of the LORD;
this is what I desire:
to dwell in the house of the LORD
all the days of my life,
to gaze on the beauty of the LORD
and seek Him in His temple.

PSA.27.5.t: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
s: For in the day of trouble
He will hide me in His shelter;
He will conceal me under the cover of His tent;
He will set me high upon a rock.

PSA.27.7.t: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.
s: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call;
be merciful and answer me.

PSA.27.8.t: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
s: My heart said, “Seek His face.”
Your face, O LORD, I will seek.

PSA.27.9.t: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
s: Hide not Your face from me,
nor turn away Your servant in anger.
You have been my helper;
do not leave me or forsake me,
O God of my salvation.

PSA.27.10.t: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
s: Though my father and mother forsake me,
the LORD will receive me.

PSA.27.11.t: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
s: Teach me Your way, O LORD,
and lead me on a level path,
because of my oppressors.

PSA.27.12.t: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
s: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes,
for false witnesses rise up against me,
breathing out violence.

PSA.27.13.t: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
s: Still I am certain to see
the goodness of the LORD
in the land of the living.

PSA.27.14.t: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
s: Wait patiently for the LORD;
be strong and courageous.
Wait patiently for the LORD!

PSA.31.9.t: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
s: Be merciful to me, O LORD,
for I am in distress;
my eyes fail from sorrow,
my soul and body as well.

PSA.31.10.t: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
s: For my life is consumed with grief
and my years with groaning;
my iniquity has drained my strength,
and my bones are wasting away.

PSA.31.11.t: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
s: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace,
and among my neighbors even more.
I am dreaded by my friends—
they flee when they see me on the street.

PSA.31.12.t: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
s: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind.
I am like a broken vessel.

PSA.31.13.t: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
s: For I hear the slander of many;
there is terror on every side.
They conspire against me
and plot to take my life.

PSA.31.14.t: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
s: But I trust in You, O LORD;
I say, “You are my God.”

PSA.31.15.t: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
s: My times are in Your hands;
deliver me from my enemies
and from those who pursue me.

PSA.31.16.t: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.
s: Make Your face shine on Your servant;
save me by Your loving devotion.

PSA.32.1.t: Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
s: Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven,
whose sins are covered.

PSA.32.2.t: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
s: Blessed is the man
whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him,
in whose spirit there is no deceit.

PSA.32.3.t: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
s: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle
from my groaning all day long.

PSA.32.4.t: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
s: For day and night
Your hand was heavy upon me;
my strength was drained
as in the summer heat.
Selah

PSA.32.5.t: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
s: Then I acknowledged my sin to You
and did not hide my iniquity.
I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,”
and You forgave the guilt of my sin.
Selah

PSA.32.6.t: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
s: Therefore let all the godly pray to You
while You may be found.
Surely when great waters rise,
they will not come near.

PSA.32.7.t: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
s: You are my hiding place.
You protect me from trouble;
You surround me with songs of deliverance.
Selah

PSA.32.8.t: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
s: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go;
I will give you counsel and watch over you.

PSA.32.9.t: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
s: Do not be like the horse or mule,
which have no understanding;
they must be controlled with bit and bridle
to make them come to you.

PSA.32.10.t: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
s: Many are the sorrows of the wicked,
but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.

PSA.32.11.t: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
s: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones;
shout for joy, all you upright in heart.

PSA.34.17.t: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
s: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears;
He delivers them from all their troubles.

PSA.34.18.t: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
s: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted;
He saves the contrite in spirit.

PSA.34.19.t: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
s: Many are the afflictions of the righteous,
but the LORD delivers him from them all.

PSA.37.23.t: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
s: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD
who takes delight in his journey.

PSA.37.24.t: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
s: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed,
for the LORD is holding his hand.

PSA.37.25.t: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
s: I once was young and now am old,
yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned
or their children begging for bread.

PSA.37.26.t: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
s: They are ever generous and quick to lend,
and their children are a blessing.

PSA.41.1.t: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
s: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor;
the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
PSA.41.1.h: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.

PSA.41.2.t: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes.
s: The LORD will protect and preserve him;
He will bless him in the land
and refuse to surrender him
to the will of his foes.

PSA.41.3.t: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
s: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness
and restore him from his bed of sickness.

PSA.41.4.t: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
s: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me;
heal me, for I have sinned against You.”

PSA.42.5.t: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
s: Why are you downcast, O my soul?
Why the unease within me?
Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him
for the salvation of His presence.

PSA.42.6.t: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon— even from Mount Mizar.
s: O my God, my soul despairs within me.
Therefore I remember You
from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon—
even from Mount Mizar.

PSA.42.7.t: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
s: Deep calls to deep
in the roar of Your waterfalls;
all Your breakers and waves
have rolled over me.

PSA.42.8.t: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
s: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day,
and at night His song is with me
as a prayer to the God of my life.

PSA.42.9.t: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
s: I say to God my Rock,
“Why have You forgotten me?
Why must I walk in sorrow
because of the enemy’s oppression?”

PSA.42.10.t: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
s: Like the crushing of my bones,
my enemies taunt me,
while they say to me all day long,
“Where is your God?”

PSA.42.11.t: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
s: Why are you downcast, O my soul?
Why the unease within me?
Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him,
my Savior and my God.

PSA.46.1.t: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
s: God is our refuge and strength,
an ever-present help in times of trouble.
PSA.46.1.h: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song.

PSA.46.2.t: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
s: Therefore we will not fear,
though the earth is transformed
and the mountains are toppled
into the depths of the seas,

PSA.46.3.t: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
s: though their waters roar and foam
and the mountains quake in the surge.
Selah

PSA.46.4.t: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
s: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God,
the holy place where the Most High dwells.

PSA.46.5.t: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
s: God is within her; she will not be moved.
God will help her when morning dawns.

PSA.46.6.t: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
s: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble;
the earth melts when He lifts His voice.

PSA.46.7.t: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
s: The LORD of Hosts is with us;
the God of Jacob is our fortress.
Selah

PSA.46.8.t: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
s: Come, see the works of the LORD,
who brings devastation upon the earth.

PSA.46.9.t: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
s: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth;
He breaks the bow and shatters the spear;
He burns the shields in the fire.

PSA.46.10.t: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
s: “Be still and know that I am God;
I will be exalted among the nations,
I will be exalted over the earth.”

PSA.46.11.t: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
s: The LORD of Hosts is with us;
the God of Jacob is our fortress.
Selah

PSA.56.1.t: Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
s: Be merciful to me, O God,
for men are hounding me;
all day they press their attack.
PSA.56.1.h: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.

PSA.56.2.t: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
s: My enemies pursue me all day long,
for many proudly assail me.

PSA.56.3.t: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
s: When I am afraid,
I put my trust in You.

PSA.56.4.t: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
s: In God, whose word I praise—
in God I trust.
I will not be afraid.
What can man do to me?

PSA.56.5.t: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.
s: All day long they twist my words;
all their thoughts are on my demise.

PSA.56.6.t: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
s: They conspire, they lurk,
they watch my steps
while they wait to take my life.

PSA.56.7.t: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
s: In spite of such sin, will they escape?
In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.

PSA.56.8.t: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle— are they not in Your book?
s: You have taken account of my wanderings.
Put my tears in Your bottle—
are they not in Your book?

PSA.56.9.t: Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help. By this I will know that God is on my side.
s: Then my enemies will retreat
on the day I cry for help.
By this I will know that God is on my side.

PSA.56.10.t: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
s: In God, whose word I praise,
in the LORD, whose word I praise,

PSA.56.11.t: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
s: in God I trust; I will not be afraid.
What can man do to me?

PSA.62.1.t: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
s: In God alone my soul finds rest;
my salvation comes from Him.
PSA.62.1.h: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.

PSA.62.2.t: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
s: He alone is my rock and my salvation.
He is my fortress;
I will never be shaken.

PSA.62.3.t: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
s: How long will you threaten a man?
Will all of you throw him down
like a leaning wall
or a tottering fence?

PSA.62.4.t: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
s: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch;
they delight in lies;
with their mouths they bless,
but inwardly they curse.
Selah

PSA.62.5.t: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
s: Rest in God alone, O my soul,
for my hope comes from Him.

PSA.62.6.t: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
s: He alone is my rock and my salvation;
He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.

PSA.62.7.t: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
s: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock;
my refuge is in God.

PSA.62.8.t: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
s: Trust in Him at all times, O people;
pour out your hearts before Him.
God is our refuge.
Selah

PSA.62.9.t: Lowborn men are but a vapor, the exalted but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
s: Lowborn men are but a vapor,
the exalted but a lie.
Weighed on the scale, they go up;
together they are but a vapor.

PSA.62.10.t: Place no trust in extortion, or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
s: Place no trust in extortion,
or false hope in stolen goods.
If your riches increase,
do not set your heart upon them.

PSA.62.11.t: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,
s: God has spoken once;
I have heard this twice:
that power belongs to God,

PSA.62.12.t: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
s: and loving devotion to You, O Lord.
For You will repay each man
according to his deeds.

PSA.68.3.t: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
s: But the righteous will be glad
and rejoice before God;
they will celebrate with joy.

PSA.68.4.t: Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds — His name is the LORD— and rejoice before Him.
s: Sing to God!
Sing praises to His name.
Exalt Him who rides on the clouds —
His name is the LORD—
and rejoice before Him.

PSA.68.5.t: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in His holy habitation.
s: A father of the fatherless,
and a defender of the widows,
is God in His holy habitation.

PSA.68.6.t: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
s: God settles the lonely in families;
He leads the prisoners out to prosperity,

PSA.71.1.t: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.

let me never be put to shame.

s: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me;
incline Your ear and save me.

s: Be my rock of refuge,
where I can always go.
Give the command to save me,
for You are my rock and my fortress.

from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.

PSA.71.5.t: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
s: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD,
my confidence from my youth.

and the swallow a nest for herself,
where she places her young near Your altars,
O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.

s: So teach us to number our days,

PSA.90.13.t: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
s: Return, O LORD! How long will it be?
Have compassion on Your servants.

PSA.90.14.t: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
s: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion,
that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

establish for us the work of our hands—
yes, establish the work of our hands!

s: Who will rise up for me against the wicked?
Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?

PSA.94.17.t: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.
s: Unless the LORD had been my helper,
I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.

PSA.94.18.t: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
s: If I say, “My foot is slipping,”
Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.

PSA.94.19.t: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
s: When anxiety overwhelms me,
Your consolation delights my soul.

PSA.94.20.t: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally— one devising mischief by decree?
s: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally—
one devising mischief by decree?

PSA.94.22.t: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.

and my God is my rock of refuge.

PSA.100.1.t: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
s: Make a joyful noise to the LORD,
all the earth.

PSA.100.2.t: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
s: Serve the LORD with gladness;
come into His presence with joyful songs.

we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.

s: Enter His gates with thanksgiving

give thanks to Him and bless His name.

and His loving devotion endures forever;
His faithfulness continues to all generations.

PSA.103.8.t: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
s: The LORD is compassionate and gracious,
slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.

PSA.103.9.t: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
s: He will not always accuse us,
nor harbor His anger forever.

s: He has not dealt with us according to our sins
or repaid us according to our iniquities.

s: For as high as the heavens are above the earth,
so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.

PSA.103.12.t: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
s: As far as the east is from the west,
so far has He removed our transgressions from us.

PSA.103.13.t: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
s: As a father has compassion on his children,
so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.

PSA.103.14.t: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
s: For He knows our frame;
He is mindful that we are dust.

s: As for man, his days are like grass—
he blooms like a flower of the field;

PSA.103.16.t: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
s: when the wind passes over, it vanishes,
and its place remembers it no more.

s: But from everlasting to everlasting
the loving devotion of the LORD
extends to those who fear Him,
and His righteousness to their children’s children—

PSA.103.18.t: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
s: to those who keep His covenant
and remember to obey His precepts.

PSA.111.1.t: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
s: Hallelujah!
I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart
in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

PSA.111.2.t: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
s: Great are the works of the LORD;
they are pondered by all who delight in them.

PSA.111.3.t: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
s: Splendid and majestic is His work;
His righteousness endures forever.

s: He has caused His wonders to be remembered;
the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

He remembers His covenant forever.

all His precepts are trustworthy.

s: They are upheld forever and ever,
enacted in truth and uprightness.

He has ordained His covenant forever;
holy and awesome is His name.

s: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom;
all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding.
His praise endures forever!

s: How can a young man keep his way pure?
By guarding it according to Your word.

s: With all my heart I have sought You;
do not let me stray from Your commandments.

s: I have hidden Your word in my heart
that I might not sin against You.

s: Blessed are You, O LORD;
teach me Your statutes.

PSA.119.13.t: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
s: With my lips I proclaim
all the judgments of Your mouth.

PSA.119.14.t: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
s: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies
as much as in all riches.

PSA.119.15.t: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
s: I will meditate on Your precepts
and regard Your ways.

PSA.119.16.t: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
s: I will delight in Your statutes;
I will not forget Your word.

s: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes,

for there I find delight.

s: Turn my heart to Your testimonies
and not to covetous gain.

s: Turn my eyes away from worthless things;
revive me with Your word.

s: Establish Your word to Your servant,
to produce reverence for You.

s: Turn away the disgrace I dread,
for Your judgments are good.

Revive me in Your righteousness.

s: Your word is a lamp to my feet

PSA.119.106.t: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
s: I have sworn and confirmed
that I will keep Your righteous judgments.

s: I am severely afflicted, O LORD;
revive me through Your word.

s: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD,
and teach me Your judgments.

s: I constantly take my life in my hands,
yet I do not forget Your law.

s: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes,
even to the very end.

my eyes are not haughty.
I do not aspire to great things
or matters too lofty for me.

like a weaned child is my soul within me.

both now and forevermore.

running down on the beard,

of life forevermore.

s: I give You thanks with all my heart;
before the gods I sing Your praises.

s: I bow down toward Your holy temple
and give thanks to Your name
for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness;
You have exalted Your name
and Your word above all else.

You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.

for the glory of the LORD is great.

He attends to the lowly;
but the proud He knows from afar.

You preserve me from the anger of my foes;
You extend Your hand,
and Your right hand saves me.

do not abandon the works of Your hands.

s: O LORD, You have searched me
and known me.

You understand my thoughts from afar.

You are aware of all my ways.

You know all about it, O LORD.

You have laid Your hand upon me.

s: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me,
too lofty for me to attain.

Where can I flee from Your presence?

if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.

s: If I rise on the wings of the dawn,
if I settle by the farthest sea,

You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

and I know this very well.

when I was made in secret,
when I was woven together
in the depths of the earth.

s: Your eyes saw my unformed body;
all my days were written in Your book

before one of them came to be.

how vast is their sum!

they would outnumber the grains of sand;
and when I awake,
I am still with You.

s: You open Your hand
and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

s: The LORD is righteous in all His ways
and kind in all His deeds.

s: The LORD is near to all who call on Him,
to all who call out to Him in truth.

make music on the harp to our God,

who prepares rain for the earth,
who makes grass to grow on the hills.

who hope in His loving devotion.

ROM.8.23.t: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.
s: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.

ROM.8.24.t: For in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he can already see?
s: For in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he can already see?

ROM.8.25.t: But if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.
s: But if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.

ROM.8.26.t: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
s: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.

ROM.8.27.t: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
s: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.

ROM.8.31.t: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
s: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

ROM.8.32.t: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?
s: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?

ROM.8.33.t: Who will bring any charge against God’s elect? It is God who justifies.
s: Who will bring any charge against God’s elect? It is God who justifies.

ROM.8.34.t: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us.
s: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us.

ROM.8.35.t: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
s: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

ROM.8.36.t: As it is written: “For Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.”
s: As it is written:
“For Your sake we face death all day long;
we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.”

ROM.8.37.t: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.
s: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.

ROM.8.38.t: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,
s: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,

ROM.8.39.t: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
s: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ROM.12.1.t: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
s: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.

ROM.12.2.t: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
s: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.

ROM.12.3.t: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.
s: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.

ROM.12.4.t: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and not all members have the same function,
s: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and not all members have the same function,

ROM.12.5.t: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.
s: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.

ROM.12.9.t: Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
s: Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.

ROM.12.10.t: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.
s: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.

ROM.12.11.t: Do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.
s: Do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.

ROM.12.12.t: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.
s: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.

ROM.12.13.t: Share with the saints who are in need. Practice hospitality.
s: Share with the saints who are in need. Practice hospitality.

ROM.12.14.t: Bless those who persecute you. Bless and do not curse.
s: Bless those who persecute you. Bless and do not curse.

ROM.12.15.t: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
s: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.

ROM.12.16.t: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but enjoy the company of the lowly. Do not be conceited.
s: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but enjoy the company of the lowly. Do not be conceited.

ROM.12.17.t: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.
s: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.

ROM.12.18.t: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.
s: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.

ROM.12.19.t: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
s: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”

ROM.12.20.t: On the contrary, “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink. For in so doing, you will heap burning coals on his head.”
s: On the contrary,
“If your enemy is hungry, feed him;
if he is thirsty, give him a drink.
For in so doing,
you will heap burning coals on his head.”

ROM.12.21.t: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
s: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

ROM.13.6.t: This is also why you pay taxes. For the authorities are God’s servants, who devote themselves to their work.
s: This is also why you pay taxes. For the authorities are God’s servants, who devote themselves to their work.

ROM.13.7.t: Pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.
s: Pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.

ROM.13.8.t: Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. For he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
s: Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. For he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

ROM.13.9.t: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
s: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”

ROM.13.10.t: Love does no wrong to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
s: Love does no wrong to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.

SNG.2.1.t: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valley.
s: I am a rose of Sharon,
a lily of the valley.

SNG.2.2.t: Like a lily among the thorns is my darling among the maidens.
s: Like a lily among the thorns
is my darling among the maidens.

SNG.2.3.t: Like an apricot tree among the trees of the forest is my beloved among the young men. I delight to sit in his shade, and his fruit is sweet to my taste.
s: Like an apricot tree among the trees of the forest
is my beloved among the young men.
I delight to sit in his shade,
and his fruit is sweet to my taste.

SNG.2.4.t: He has brought me to the house of wine, and his banner over me is love.
s: He has brought me to the house of wine,
and his banner over me is love.

SNG.2.5.t: Sustain me with raisins; refresh me with apples, for I am faint with love.
s: Sustain me with raisins;
refresh me with apples,
for I am faint with love.

SNG.2.6.t: His left hand is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.
s: His left hand is under my head,
and his right arm embraces me.

SNG.2.7.t: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right.
s: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you
by the gazelles and does of the field:
Do not arouse or awaken love
until the time is right.

SNG.8.5.t: Who is this coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? I roused you under the apple tree; there your mother conceived you; there she travailed and brought you forth.
s: Who is this coming up from the wilderness,
leaning on her beloved?
I roused you under the apple tree;
there your mother conceived you;
there she travailed and brought you forth.

SNG.8.6.t: Set me as a seal over your heart, as a seal upon your arm. For love is as strong as death, its jealousy as unrelenting as Sheol. Its sparks are fiery flames, the fiercest blaze of all.
s: Set me as a seal over your heart,
as a seal upon your arm.
For love is as strong as death,
its jealousy as unrelenting as Sheol.
Its sparks are fiery flames,
the fiercest blaze of all.

SNG.8.7.t: Mighty waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot sweep it away. If a man were to give all the wealth of his house for love, his offer would be utterly scorned.
s: Mighty waters cannot quench love;
rivers cannot sweep it away.
If a man were to give all the wealth of his house for love,
his offer would be utterly scorned.

ZEP.3.14.t: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
s: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion;
shout aloud, O Israel!
Be glad and rejoice with all your heart,
O Daughter of Jerusalem!

ZEP.3.15.t: The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.
s: The LORD has taken away your punishment;
He has turned back your enemy.
Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you;
no longer will you fear any harm.

ZEP.3.16.t: On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.
s: On that day they will say to Jerusalem:
“Do not fear, O Zion;
do not let your hands fall limp.

ZEP.3.17.t: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
s: The LORD your God is among you;
He is mighty to save.
He will rejoice over you with gladness;
He will quiet you with His love;
He will rejoice over you with singing.”

ZEP.3.18.t: “I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
s: “I will gather those among you who grieve
over the appointed feasts,
so that you will no longer suffer reproach.

ZEP.3.19.t: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered; and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth.
s: Behold, at that time,
I will deal with all who afflict you.
I will save the lame
and gather the scattered;
and I will appoint praise and fame
for the disgraced throughout the earth.

ZEP.3.20.t: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.
s: At that time I will bring you in;
yes, at that time I will gather you.
For I will give you fame and praise
among all the peoples of the earth
when I restore your captives
before your very eyes,”
says the LORD.
